text: Did you know that having dogs and cats in your house is one of the most powerful protections that exist? Before something bad enters your home, your animals already know it. They fight battles for you while you sleep peacefully. What for you is a bark at nothing, for your dog is a defense against what you cannot see. Your dog is a guardian, detects energetic danger before anyone else, gets alert, positions itself between you and the door, barks at empty corners, growls without apparent reason. It's not crazy, it's working. Your cat does the opposite but equally powerful, doesn't fight, absorbs, sits exactly where the energy is densest, stares fixedly at places that for you are empty, and when it curls up on top of you it's not seeking warmth. It's cleaning what you carry. In our monastery we have always had both. The dog protects the entrance, the cat cleans what already entered. Together they are the most complete protection system that exists. They are not simple pets. They are guardians that came into your life to protect your home and your soul. If your dog barks at night for no reason, don't silence it. It's warning. If your cat stares fixedly at a point, let it. It's working. Take care of them. Respect them. Thank them. They do for you more than you imagine. Write in the comments, my guardians, if you have a dog or a cat at home. But I want you to understand something. Your animals protect you from what comes from outside. But what hurts you most often doesn't come from outside. It comes from within. The stress you drag. The emotions you accumulate. The fear you don't release. That cannot be clean by even the best guardian. Your animals protect your space. But your inner peace. But your inner peace only you can build. And if you want to learn to build that peace that your animals already know you need, I have been learning in silence for more than 20 years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
